title: Fever and respiratory symptoms
text: Assess fever with cough for respiratory distress, dehydration, and persistent high fever. Refer urgently when danger signs are present.

title: Skin rash or wound
text: Inspect wounds and rashes for spreading redness, pus, fever, severe pain, or involvement near eyes. Avoid prescription medicines without clinician review.

title: Red eye or eye infection
actions: Refer urgently for trauma or vision loss
text: Red eye with pain, injury, light sensitivity, or vision change requires urgent referral. Mild discharge without danger signs can be reviewed at PHC.

title: Diarrhea and dehydration
text: Check for dehydration, blood in stool, lethargy, and inability to drink. Refer immediately when danger signs are present.
